# LPL Financial Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results


LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) (the "Company") today announced results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting net income of $357 million, or $4.52 per share.


Last Edited by: LPL Financial


Last Updated: October 27, 2026
